data.name: Gravemore
data.detailed_description:
Gravemore is a realistic and intense first-person co-op horror experience for two players.

After a failed attempt to escape in a broken car, you and your partner are forced to descend into the abandoned tunnels of an old sewer system. The only path to survival is to trap the creature hunting you — a Werewolf guided by sound and the scent of blood.

To do that, you’ll have to explore the dark underground, capture rats, and use them as bait to lure the beast into a reinforced cage. Every step echoes through the tunnels, every dropped object can reveal your position. Communication and silence are your greatest weapons.

Key Features

  • 🐺 Dynamic Werewolf AI: A reactive and unpredictable enemy that listens, tracks, and hunts using advanced sound detection and player movement.

  • 👥 Two-Player Co-op: Work together to catch rats, solve objectives, and survive in the twisting labyrinth below.

  • 🔦 Full Physical Interaction: Install parts, open gates, set traps, and carry items with realistic physics and weight.

  • 🌑 Immersive Atmosphere: Dense darkness, spatial audio, and echoing reverb that brings the tunnels to life.

  • 🔁 Replayability: Randomized item locations, events, and creature behavior ensure every run feels new.

Future Updates

Gravemore will continue to expand after release, introducing new maps, additional entities, and new challenges that deepen the cooperative horror experience.

Prepare for the fear that comes from below — and the sound that may reveal where you are.

data.short_description: Gravemore is a realistic first-person co-op horror experience for two players. After your car mysteriously fails, you must descend into the abandoned sewers and find a way to trap the Werewolf — using dead rats as bait to lure it into a cage. Silence is your only weapon.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 or new-gen i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required / Not compatible with Mac Products
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel i7 or AMD equivalent (AMD FX 9500+ Series)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required / Not compatible with Mac Products
